scope: All overview, actual final P1-P6 solutions, every explicit trace/table, hints, extensions, assumptions and attribution independently reviewed; corrected five-page guide inspected.

P1.lower_bound: Fewer than n-1 graph edges leave a component not containing lane1; a minimum in it cannot leave.

P2.half_order: Each of lanes1,2 is at most each of lanes3,4; within halves need not sort.

P3.lower_bound: A fixed successful swap record determines one distinct start from the sorted output; 2^2<6.

P5.tags: Identifiers never affect compare-exchange; ties stay.

P6.general_invariant: An adjacent swap changes relative order only for its two exchanged cards; equal cards never swap. Induction preserves every equal pair for any machine length even without value sorting.

five_bar_sorter_extension.proof: First two bars establish sorted-pair promise; proved merger then sorts values universally.

resolved_findings: P4 guide trace corrected: 1,3,4,2 outputs 1,2,4,3. Correction verified in current JSON and rendered PDF.
